factual_claims.source_evidence: Condensed statement of financial position shows Inventories for 31.12.2025: 1,562,500 and 31.12.2024: 1,471,238. Note 3 Inventories states: 'In 2025 the increase in value of the inventories resulted from investments made into the property development project in the total amount of 91,262 euros.' Management report states: 'AS Trigon Property Development currently owns one real estate development project involving a 13.2-hectare area in the City of Pärnu, Estonia.'
